title: Understanding Linear Momentum
text: Linear momentum is calculated using the formula: momentum $$=$$ mass × velocity. To find Earth's linear momentum, we need to know its mass and velocity.

title: Finding Earth's Velocity
text: Earth's velocity in its orbit can be calculated using the formula: velocity $$=$$ $$2\pi$$ × radius / time period. The time period for Earth's orbit is approximately $$365.25$$ days.

title: Converting Time Period to Seconds
text: Convert the time period from days to seconds to use in the velocity formula.

title: Calculate Earth's Velocity
text: Using the formula velocity $$=$$ $$2\pi$$ × radius / time period, calculate Earth's velocity. Use radius $$=$$ $$1.50\times10**{11}\,\text{m}$$ and time period in seconds.

title: Calculate Earth's Linear Momentum
text: Now that you have Earth's velocity, use the formula momentum $$=$$ mass × velocity to find Earth's linear momentum. Use mass $$=$$ $$5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$ and velocity from the previous step.
